pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 8.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: ADVERTISEMENTS AND NEWS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Advertisements and News
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Advertisements and News, part of Strand 8 in Grade 4 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why are advertisements important? 2. How do we describe objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. make personal collections from newspaper cuttings of advertisements to form a personal booklet,

2. work collaboratively with peers to view and read the selected advertisements from newspapers and magazines,

3. role play a news report bulletin to describe objects/products based on aspects such as colour, size and shape,

4. jointly work with peers to use digital devices to recreate content from adverts,

5. play a ‘Pictionary vocabulary game’ with peers to describe an item,

6. read and answer questions on advertisements and news correctly, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. make personal collections from newspaper cuttings of advertisements to form a personal booklet,
2. work collaboratively with peers to view and read the selected advertisements from newspapers and magazines,
3. role play a news report bulletin to describe objects/products based on aspects such as colour, size and shape,
4. jointly work with peers to use digital devices to recreate content from adverts,
5. play a ‘Pictionary vocabulary game’ with peers to describe an item,
6. read and answer questions on advertisements and news correctly, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Advertisements and News together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: This is enhanced as the learner analyses concepts when reading and answering

questions on adverts and news items correctly.

• Learning to Learn: This is developed as the learner engages in collective learning when recreating content from adverts using

digital devices.

Values:
• Unity: This is enhanced as the learner works harmoniously to prepare posters and adverts for an indigenous product and

display in class.

• Responsibility: This is enhanced as the learner engages in assigned roles when roleplaying a news report bulletin to describe

objects/products.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Civic responsibility: This is enhanced as the learner is exposed to responsible practices in product promotion.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate vocabulary related to advertisements and news items to their learning of product promotion in Science and

Technology.
